ABOUT

Turning data into decisions.

I’m an AI engineer based in Cairo. I work with Python, deep learning, FastAPI, vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation to build predictive models and AI-powered applications.

My strengths are data analysis, feature engineering, model optimisation and business intelligence. I’m currently completing a postgraduate diploma in AI and data science at NTI, after a Pre-Master’s in Software Engineering at Cairo University.
